title: The Town Mouse and the Country Mouse

sents.en: One day, Town Mouse went to visit his cousin.
sents.ko: 어느 날, 도시 쥐가 사촌을 찾아갔어요.

sents.en: Country Mouse welcomed Town Mouse into his home.
sents.ko: 시골 쥐는 도시 쥐를 집으로 반갑게 맞았어요.

sents.en: 'Your home is small,' Town Mouse said.
sents.ko: "네 집은 작구나." 도시 쥐가 말했어요.

sents.en: 'But it's warm and peaceful,' Country Mouse said.
sents.ko: "하지만 따뜻하고 평화로워." 시골 쥐가 말했어요.

sents.en: Country Mouse served Town Mouse dinner.
sents.ko: 시골 쥐는 도시 쥐에게 저녁을 차려 주었어요.

sents.en: 'Everything is much better in town,' Town Mouse said.
sents.ko: "도시가 모든 게 훨씬 좋아." 도시 쥐가 말했어요.

sents.en: 'Come with me and I'll show you how to live,' Town Mouse said.
sents.ko: "나랑 같이 가자. 어떻게 사는지 보여 줄게." 도시 쥐가 말했어요.

sents.en: 'Your home is very large,' Country Mouse said.
sents.ko: "네 집은 정말 크구나." 시골 쥐가 말했어요.

sents.en: 'Are you hungry, cousin?' Town Mouse asked.
sents.ko: "사촌, 배고프니?" 도시 쥐가 물었어요.

sents.en: 'Yes, I am,' said Country Mouse.
sents.ko: "응, 배고파." 시골 쥐가 말했어요.

sents.en: 'This is what we eat in town,' Town Mouse said.
sents.ko: "도시에서는 이런 걸 먹어." 도시 쥐가 말했어요.

sents.en: Suddenly, the cousins heard barking.
sents.ko: 갑자기 사촌들은 개 짖는 소리를 들었어요.

sents.en: They had to run and hide.
sents.ko: 둘은 달려가 숨어야 했어요.

sents.en: Once the dogs left, Country Mouse said good-bye to Town Mouse.
sents.ko: 개들이 떠나자, 시골 쥐는 도시 쥐에게 작별 인사를 했어요.

sents.en: 'Better beans and bacon in peace than cakes in fear,' he said.
sents.ko: "두려움 속의 케이크보다, 평화로운 콩과 베이컨이 더 좋아." 시골 쥐가 말했어요.

sents.en: The moral of the story is: Better a little in safety, than much surrounded by danger.
sents.ko: 이 이야기의 교훈은 이래요 — 위험에 둘러싸인 많은 것보다, 안전한 조금이 더 낫다.

sents.en: That was an interesting story.
sents.ko: 정말 재미있는 이야기였어요.

sents.en: The Town Mouse and the Country Mouse were so different.
sents.ko: 도시 쥐와 시골 쥐는 정말 달랐어요.

sents.en: Which one do you like better?
sents.ko: 여러분은 어느 쪽이 더 좋나요?

sents.en: The Town Mouse? Or the Country Mouse?
sents.ko: 도시 쥐? 아니면 시골 쥐?
